item.title: SwiftLee launches AI Fundamentals course on agentic engineering
item.description:
Antoine van der Lee (SwiftLee) has launched a new course, AI Fundamentals, built around what he calls agentic engineering: a shift in how software gets built where developers write less code themselves and spend more time describing outcomes, reviewing agent-produced changes, and improving the systems around their agents.

The course grew out of his own change in workflow, and it's aimed at developers trying to move past using AI as a fancy autocomplete and toward treating agents as part of the engineering process. For Swift developers watching AI reshape day-to-day coding, it's a practical, iOS-world take on a shift that's hitting every platform.

Sources

  • SwiftLee: Agentic engineering: why I built the AI Fundamentals course
